english.title: Engage in watersport failing to comply with harbour masters permission - Port of Liverpool
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were engaged or took part in

(A)_[water skiing]_
(B)_[aquaplaning]_
(C)_[paragliding]_
(D)_[power boat racing]_
(E)_[parakiting]_
(F)_[parachute towing]_
(G)_[a watersport activity, namely **(..SPECIFY ACTIVITY..),]_

and failed to comply with the

(H)_[written permission of the harbour master as to the specified area]_
(I)_[conditions of the written permission of the harbour master]_

namely **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 38(h) and 39(a) of the Port of Liverpool General Byelaws 2021.
